LESSON: GUIDED WRITING

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Writing
Topic 3.2: Guided Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 1

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Writing, part of Writing in Grade 9 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to follow the rules of writing Chinese characters?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. search online or offline for the rules of writing Chinese characters and list them down,

2. watch an audio-visual clip modelling the rules of writing characters and practise writing the given words,

3. work together to categorise titles of nuclear and extended family into paternal and maternal members,

4. match pictures of various professions to their places of work (e.g. 老师 to 学校 etc.),

5. fill a crossword puzzle with the names of different professions collaboratively,

6. describe their nuclear and extended family members in writing ( names, age, profession and places of work),

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. search online or offline for the rules of writing Chinese characters and list them down,
2. watch an audio-visual clip modelling the rules of writing characters and practise writing the given words,
3. work together to categorise titles of nuclear and extended family into paternal and maternal members,
4. match pictures of various professions to their places of work (e.g. 老师 to 学校 etc.),
5. fill a crossword puzzle with the names of different professions collaboratively,
6. describe their nuclear and extended family members in writing ( names, age, profession and places of work),

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: the learner writes clearly and spells words correctly when they describe their nuclear

and extended family members in simple texts.

• Self-efficacy: the learner exhibits self-awareness skills as they identify and seek help to address the challenges they faced

while creating using digital devices.

Values:
Responsibility: this is developed when the learner proactively suggests possible ways of addressing the challenges they face

when using digital devices.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Cyber Security: the learner enhances their awareness of cyber security as they discuss the challenges they face using digital

devices.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

The learner relates the concept of using appropriate digital platforms to accomplish their tasks to Pre-technical Studies.
